name: galex-ui
description: GaleX — Thunderstore mod manager UI embedded into the Steam client via Millennium

scripts.build:plugin: tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode plugin && node scripts/copy-browser-css.mjs && npm run build:config
scripts.test: npm run test:demo && npm run test:plugin && npm run test:webkit && npm run test:config
scripts.test:demo: vite build --ssr scripts/demo.test.ts --outDir dist-test --emptyOutDir && node dist-test/demo.test.js
scripts.test:plugin: npm run build:plugin && npm run build:webkit && node scripts/plugin-smoke.mjs
scripts.build:config: node scripts/build-config-icons.mjs && vite build --config config/vite.config.ts && node scripts/inline-config-css.mjs
